It was printed in 1st Edition and Unlimited, and the 16 holo rares also exist as the famous No Set Symbol error. PSA has graded about 8,626 copies across its printings. ## Print variants & how to tell them apart Image: Vileplume 1st Edition 1st Edition The black 'Edition 1' stamp — a circle containing the number 1 — sits just left of the artwork, below the art box. Jungle has no shadowless printing, so a 1st Edition card is otherwise identical to Unlimited (same drop shadow, same set symbol). The first and smallest print run; commands a premium. Image: Vileplume Unlimited Unlimited No stamp. The standard and by far the most common Jungle printing, with the set symbol (a rafflesia-like flower) in the lower-right of the art box. The only tell vs 1st Edition is the missing stamp — both have the drop shadow and the set symbol. Image: Vileplume No Set Symbol (error) No Set Symbol (error) An early Unlimited holo printing where the Jungle set symbol (the rafflesia flower) was accidentally left off the lower-right of the art box — the card has NO set symbol. Only the 16 holo rares (#1–16) exist this way. About This Card
Vileplume is a Rare Holo Pokémon card from Jungle (Base series, released June 16, 1999), number 15 of 64, illustrated by Keiji Kinebuchi. It is a Stage 2 Grass-type Pokémon with 80 HP that evolves from Gloom.
It currently trades at $37.62 on TCGplayer (Unlimited Holofoil market price; recent listings range from $14.97 to $410). That makes it the 12th most valuable card in Jungle out of 64 priced cards, and the 8th most valuable of 26 priced Vileplume printings.
Its attack is Petal Dance (40× damage, 3 energy), and it has the ability Heal; it is weak to Fire (×2) and retreats for 2 energy.

Abilities
Heal Pokémon Power
Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Vileplume is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

Attacks
Petal Dance
Grass · Grass · Grass · 40× damage

Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. Vileplume is now Confused (after doing damage).

“The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.”

A nostalgic vintage staple for Jungle set collectors.

08Competitive Playability

Tier: None

Stage 2 Vileplume with 80 HP; top attack around 40 damage. Functions as an evolution-chain piece rather than a tournament attacker.

09Card Moves and Abilities

Ability: Heal

Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Vileplume is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

Petal Dance Cost: Grass + Grass + Grass · 40× damage
Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads. Vileplume is now Confused (after doing damage).

WeaknessFire ×2Retreat cost2

Chronicling the buildup to the global tournament taking place in the United States, Mexico and Canada, 2025-26 Panini Select Road to FIFA World Cup 2026 Soccer highlights national team stars in contention for qualification.

Hobby boxes ($499.95) average three autographs or relics, along with multiple parallels and inserts. There's also the 1st Off the Line (FOTL) format with exclusive content.

This release joins other Road to World Cup sets from Donruss, National Treasures and Noir.

The card designs match the club-based La Liga and Ligue 1 editions.

Jump to the 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball checklist and team set lists
[…]
Presented as a darkened Chrome product when it comes to design, there’s actually a lot of color throughout the set, which strikes an excellent contrast between the darkness and the bright.

Collectors can expect one encased autograph in every box. That comes separately from the two six-card packs.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Checklist Details

The size and scope of the base set were not announced, but collectors can count on several numbered parallels that will bring some color pops to a layered design that gives off a dimensional feel.

Autographs

The base design returns for Chrome Black Autographs and Chrome Black Rookie Autographs. Both sets will also have several colorful Refractor parallels.

Among the confirmed options are Purple (/75), Orange (/25), Rose Gold Wave (/15), White (/10), Red (/5), and Superfractor (1/1), and notable signers include LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Brunson, Cooper Flagg, and Kon Knueppel.

Super Futures Autographs also hit the hardwood, as do Ivory Autographs, which take a different approach than the base set. Instead of a blacked out design, these cards are white-heavy, making the colors of the parallels pop in a different way.

Jump to the 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball checklist and team set lists
[…]
Presented as a darkened Chrome product when it comes to design, there’s actually a lot of color throughout the set, which strikes an excellent contrast between the darkness and the bright.

Collectors can expect one encased autograph in every box. That comes separately from the two six-card packs.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Checklist Details

The size and scope of the base set were not announced, but collectors can count on several numbered parallels that will bring some color pops to a layered design that gives off a dimensional feel.

Autographs

The base design returns for Chrome Black Autographs and Chrome Black Rookie Autographs. Both sets will also have several colorful Refractor parallels.

Among the confirmed options are Purple (/75), Orange (/25), Rose Gold Wave (/15), White (/10), Red (/5), and Superfractor (1/1), and notable signers include LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Brunson, Cooper Flagg, and Kon Knueppel.

Super Futures Autographs also hit the hardwood, as do Ivory Autographs, which take a different approach than the base set. Instead of a blacked out design, these cards are white-heavy, making the colors of the parallels pop in a different way.

New to the Chrome Black brand are Glow Up Signatures. Featuring only rising talent, these cards will remind collectors of the potential of the best up-and-comers in the game.
[…]
Exclusive to these packs are Teal Glitter (/64) and Black Glitter (/11) parallels.

Cards per pack: Hobby – 6

Packs per box: Hobby – 2

Boxes per case: Hobby – 12

Set size: 150 cards

Presented as a darkened Chrome product when it comes to design, there’s actually a lot of color throughout the set, which strikes an excellent contrast between the darkness and the bright.

Collectors can expect one encased autograph in every box. That comes separately from the two six-card packs.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball Checklist Details

The size and scope of the base set were not announced, but collectors can count on several numbered parallels that will bring some color pops to a layered design that gives off a dimensional feel.

Autographs

The base design returns for Chrome Black Autographs and Chrome Black Rookie Autographs. Both sets will also have several colorful Refractor parallels.

Among the confirmed options are Purple (/75), Orange (/25), Rose Gold Wave (/15), White (/10), Red (/5), and Superfractor (1/1), and notable signers include LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Victor Wembanyama, Jalen Brunson, Cooper Flagg, and Kon Knueppel.

Super Futures Autographs also hit the hardwood, as do Ivory Autographs, which take a different approach than the base set. Instead of a blacked out design, these cards are white-heavy, making the colors of the parallels pop in a different way.

New to the Chrome Black brand are Glow Up Signatures. Featuring only rising talent, these cards will remind collectors of the potential of the best up-and-comers in the game.
[…]

Discover 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball

Date: Aug 27, 2026

Topics: 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball, Basketball, Instant Packs, NBA, SKU Guide, Trending

Length: 1830 Words

Reading Time: ~10 Minutes

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball brings back its signature dark aesthetic, pairing bold card designs with a premium chromium finish. Collectors can find the biggest names in basketball, from established stars like Victor Wembanyama, LeBron James, and Stephen Curry to exciting rookies like Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, and Kon Knueppel.

The insert lineup features returning favorites Black Lightning, Nocturnal, and Home Court, joined by two new additions, Carbon Flare and Obscura.

The autograph lineup runs just as deep, with Autographs, Rookie Autographs, Ivory Autographs, Super Futures Autographs, and the new Glow Up Signatures joining Carbon Ink, Black Fire Autographs, and Shrouded Signatures. Every box includes numbered parallels and one encased autograph card.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball comes in two formats: physical Hobby boxes and the new Instant Packs available on Fanatics Collect. Both draw from the same print run and checklist, so the right format depends on whether you want to open sealed wax at home or rip instantly online. Here’s a breakdown of what each format offers.

2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball is available in two formats: physical Hobby boxes and digital Instant Packs on Fanatics Collect. Every Hobby box includes two packs of six cards plus one encased autograph card, while Instant Packs deliver four cards from the same print run, plus two exclusive parallels. Collectors can find Victor Wembanyama, LeBron James, Stephen Curry, and top rookies like Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, and Kon Knueppel across a signature dark chromium design.

In 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball, collectors are looking for autographs from the game’s biggest current stars, its most exciting rookies, and basketball legends, all set against the release’s signature dark chromium design.

Established Stars: Victor Wembanyama, LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Anthony Edwards, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and Luka Doncic

Top Rookies: Cooper Flagg, Dylan Harper, and Kon Knueppel headline a rookie class featured across base cards, Home Court, and the new Glow Up Signatures autograph set

Basketball Legends: Ivory Autographs bring back some of the biggest names from basketball’s past, including Allen Iverson

What’s Inside 2025-26 Topps Chrome Black Basketball?

Base: Chrome base cards feature the league’s stars and rookies, with a full parallel ladder running from the Base Refractor, numbered to 299, through Base Blue, Green, Purple, Gold, Orange, Rose Gold, White, and Red Refractors, up to the one-of-one Base SuperFractor

Black Lightning, Nocturnal, and Home Court: Returning insert sets built around the Chrome Black brand’s dark, design-driven look

Carbon Flare and Obscura: Two new super short print insert sets joining the Chrome Black lineup for 2025-26, each capped by a one-of-one SuperFractor parallel
